title: Oxva Slim Stick Pineapple Prefilled Vape Pods
description: These Pineapple Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit deliver a tropical fruit flavour in a convenient, mess-free format. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and provides up to 600 puffs, offering a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung draw. The flavour captures the juicy sweetness of ripe Pineapple with its natural tang, making for a bright and sunny vape that feels vibrant without being overpowering. With built-in coils ensuring consistent vapour production and flavour, each pod is ready to use straight away and can be replaced quickly when finished. Supplied in a pack of two, these pods are perfect for Slim Stick users seeking an easy-to-use pod with a fresh, tropical taste.
